test.name: Timeline derives English census years from the England_Census wiki page, not the US schedule
test.description: Build a timeline for William Ashford (b. ~1838 Canterbury, Kent, England; d. 1874), a person resident only in England. The skill must read the England census schedule from the England_Census wiki page via wiki_read and expect the English decennial census years (1841, 1851, 1861, 1871) — only 1851 is documented, so 1841/1861/1871 are gaps expecting an English census. It must NOT assume the US federal years (1850/1860/1870/...), none of which apply to an England-only life.

input.user_message: Build a timeline for William Ashford.

judge_context: Should call wiki_read for the England_Census page (https://www.familysearch.org/en/wiki/England_Census) to obtain the jurisdiction's census schedule, rather than assuming the US decennial years.
Should build a chronology from the documented events (birth ~1838, 1851 census residence, marriage 1859, death 1874), all in Canterbury, Kent, England.

Should identify gaps where an English census should exist but is undocumented — the person was alive and resident in England for the 1841, 1861 and 1871 censuses (1851 is documented) — and populate expected_events with those English census years.

Must NOT list US federal census years (1850, 1860, 1870, 1880, 1900, 1910, 1920) as expected for this England-only life; the expected census years are England's (1841, 1851, 1861, 1871, ...), read from the England_Census page.
The distance dimension is N/A: all events are at the same place (Canterbury), so there is no distance-sensitive pair to judge.
